description: Rename a line, make it the default, choose the published inboundAgentId that answers its callers (gateway lines; null stops answering), set testNumbers (customer gateway and Twilio lines), rotatePairing to issue a new pairing code and sign the paired device out, or capacity (Twilio lines: concurrent calls 1–10; phone gateways, SAGOT numbers and shared routes carry one call). The deployment also caps concurrent calls overall. On a SAGOT number line testNumbers can only remove numbers (add them with lines.verifyNumber). `mode: "live"` (admin, not an assistant) lets a SAGOT number line call any number in a supported country once SAGOT has turned live calling on; otherwise it fails LIVE_MODE_UNAVAILABLE.
name: lines_update
